port.ask: Serial port the pump's To Computer socket is cabled to (COM8, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: New Era cable CBL-PC-PUMP to a PC serial port, or with the CBL-USB232 adapter to USB (a virtual COM port).

address.ask: Pump network address shown in the pump's setup (0 for a single pump)
address.help: 0-99. The driver prefixes it to every command; a pump ignores commands for other addresses. Several pumps on one cable need distinct addresses, set with *ADR n.

baud.ask: Baud rate as set in the pump's setup (factory 19200)
